task: Task 10 — whole-document single-prompt arm (PILOT, n=1 per state)
⚠️_STATUS: PROVISIONAL on TWO counts, both blocking. (1) n=1 per state — this arm is a single nondeterministic call per document and is MORE exposed to sampling than the chunked method; re-run at --stability-runs 3. (2) The KY and CO columns are graded against goldens now under review in paper/results/task9_20260905/review/; a golden change moves those denominators. The CA finding is NOT affected — zero elements were produced, so no golden is consulted.
arm: whole-document single prompt: one call per document, no Pass-1 depth map, no chunking, no deterministic repairs
graded_by: evaluation.eval_detector.evaluate_state — the same grader, matcher and goldens as the full method
⚠️_scope: Every state's subset extraction is 3.7K-7.9K tokens and fits in one prompt. A result here therefore speaks to the _only_subset tier ONLY; it says nothing about the trimmed or full tiers, where the document does not fit and chunking is not optional.
⚠️_code_accuracy_denominators: Code accuracy is graded over MATCHED PAIRS ONLY. Where recall differs the denominators differ: CO's arm figure 3/3 covers three of seven golden elements and must never be printed beside the full method's 7/7 unqualified. AZ/KY/NV/TX match on every element, so those columns are directly comparable.

findings.1_categorical_failure_on_CA: CA's single call emitted EXACTLY 16,000 output tokens = detector.LLM_MAX_TOKENS. The JSON array was truncated mid-object and never closed, nothing parsed, 0 of 25 golden elements recovered — against 25/25 for the chunked method. A single prompt has ONE output budget for the whole document, so overflow loses the DOCUMENT; chunking bounds the same overflow to a CHUNK. AZ was within 11% of the same cliff (14,292/16,000) and scored 1.000, so a success here does not predict the next document.
findings.2_code_accuracy_tracks_the_missing_repai: KY 44/44 -> 28/44 and TX 8/8 -> 5/8, with recall unchanged. KY's failures are the model sampling its own abbreviation rule (MFAAA/MFAAD, PSSAU/PSAUC, WPSDS/PSDSP, EWCOM/ECOMN) — the 25% churn measured on this document on 2026-08-01 that put derive_code_from_title in Python — plus the missing de-label repair (Standard 1 vs Approaches to Learning Standard 1). TX's three are the missing anchoring (I.A vs A, I.B vs B, I.B.2 vs 2). Each is a different Aurora primary key for the same standard.
findings.3_not_a_strawman: AZ and NV score 1.000 recall with full code accuracy and no depth map, no chunking and no repairs. NV — the held-out canary whose printed namespace skips a level — comes back 46/46. Report this plainly.
findings.4_CO_level_collapse: CO recall 0.429; four of seven golden elements lost, including BOTH strands (strand tp=0 fn=2 fp=7) while emitting 61 elements. Same level-collapse signature the Task 3 depth-map ablation produces, from the same cause: no Pass-1.
